name: Arrowglide
summary:
Arrowglide is an arrow puzzle game. Each level is a board packed with arrows; tapping an arrow sends it gliding off the board in the direction it points, and an arrow blocked by another cannot move, so the player has to work out the order that clears the board. A wrong tap costs one of three hearts.

The game has more than 3,000 levels across 36 worlds, each with Easy, Hard, Super Hard and Nightmare boss boards, and introduces special arrows such as sealed gates, two-way arrows, boulders, chained pairs and fuse arrows. It also has a daily puzzle, a timed daily Sprint on a shared board, weekly seasons with medals and leaderboards.
